leadText:
(Japanese: リンカ Rinka) and (Japanese: ケンイチ Kenichi) are characters of the day who appeared in This Magik Moment!.

Rinka and Kenichi are production assistants working for Alola TV under George Charino. As George was at a television set talking to and , Rinka and Kenichi came up to him and informed him that the lead actors of the television show The Refreshing Trio: Alola Idols would not make it to the studio because their plane from Sinnoh had been caught in a blizzard. The two then panicked and asked George for advice on how to make sure the program would still air. George then decided to cast , , and for one episode.

Rinka and Kenichi are production assistants working for Alola TV under George Charino. As George was at a television set talking to and , Rinka and Kenichi came up to him and informed him that the lead actors of the television show The Refreshing Trio: Alola Idols would not make it to the studio because their plane from Sinnoh had been caught in a blizzard. The two then panicked and asked George for advice on how to make sure the program would still air. George then decided to cast , , and for one episode.

==Voice actors==
 
 

==Trivia==
Rinka and Kenichi are named and designed after their Japanese voice actors, Rinka Ōtani and Hyadain (whose real name is Kenichi Maeyamada), who are two of the co-hosts of Meet Up at the Pokémon House?. 
Rinka's design is specifically modeled after her first-ever outfit on Pokénchi.
Closed captions for the English dub refer to them as female staff member and male staff member‬.

 
Rinka Kenichi SM.png|Artwork of Rinka and Kenichi from the announcement of their guest appearance
